source.publisher: Ulster Herald (via the Irish Newspaper Archives)
source.check: returned unopposed: the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 18 May 1949 (Ulster Herald, 28 May 1949, p. 4, block images read), names the candidate in columns 2-3 and enters the name in column 5, no poll having been taken

note: Triennial election of the electoral divisions of Castlederg rural district, one member each, polled on 2 June 1949. There were no contests: with one exception (Killen) every retiring member was returned unopposed, and the new council had ten Unionists and six Nationalists (Ulster Herald, 21 May 1949, p. 5). All sixteen members are recorded from the Returning Officer's Notice of Result, dated 18 May 1949 (Ulster Herald, 28 May 1949, p. 4), which prints no labels. Returned unopposed.
